From the owner
Luxury living in Indian Springs! ✨ We just wrapped up this kitchen renovation, and honestly, we're still not over it. The massive dark wood island paired with heavily veined marble countertops sets the tone, and the custom arched range hood ties the whole space together. For the home chefs out there — this kitchen has a premium Wolf range, finished off with modern gold hardware and a matching pot-filler. We also added custom cabinet organization and a separate storage pantry, so the main kitchen stays clean and clutter-free. Ready to reimagine your own kitchen? Check out our full portfolio or reach out to the ELM team to start planning your remodel.
Jul 11, 2026
